description: This Java source file defines the class StatsByThreadNode, which models a node representing thread-specific profiling statistics in a VM trace analysis tool. It manages methods related to a specific thread, including sorting and retrieving profiling data.

classes.name: StatsByThreadNode
classes.description: Represents a profiling data node for a specific thread, providing access to method profiling info and sorting capabilities.

methods.name: StatsByThreadNode
methods.description: Constructor initializing the node with trace data and thread info, setting default sort column.

methods.name: getChildCount
methods.description: Returns the number of methods associated with the thread.

methods.name: getMethodsInThread
methods.description: Static helper method to retrieve methods invoked by the thread with invocation count > 0.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns a child node representing a specific method.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Indicates this node is not a leaf node.

methods.name: getProfileData
methods.description: Retrieves profile data for the thread's top-level call.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Returns the value for a specific column, such as name or inclusive time.

methods.name: setSortColumn
methods.description: Sorts the methods list based on specified column and order.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the thread node.
